name: Park Hyatt Los Cabos at Cabo del Sol
insider_take: Where desert luxury meets the dramatic coastline of Baja California Sur, this sophisticated retreat sits on one of Mexico's most coveted stretches of swimmable beach.
whats_special: Positioned on the iconic Cabo del Sol golf course designed by Jack Nicklaus, this ultra-modern resort features the region's largest infinity pool and direct access to one of the few swimmable beaches in Los Cabos. The property's architectural design incorporates local stone and pays homage to traditional Mexican hacienda style while maintaining Park Hyatt's signature contemporary elegance.
pro_tip: Book a suite facing southwest to catch both sunrise over the desert mountains and sunset over the Pacific - Los Cabos sits at the unique geographic point where you can witness both from the same vantage point.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature tequila and mezcal tasting experiences featuring rare small-batch spirits, plus easy access to the famous Arch of Cabo San Lucas (El Arco) - a natural rock formation where the Pacific Ocean meets the Sea of Cortez, creating a unique marine ecosystem perfect for snorkeling and whale watching during migration season.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on the Sea of Cortez with panoramic ocean views
Spacious suites and villas with private terraces and premium amenities
World-class spa and wellness facilities with authentic Mexican treatments
Exceptional dining experiences featuring local ingredients and international cuisine
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Remote location requires transportation for exploring downtown Cabo
